The community should be clearly and legibly mentioned in the certificate. OBC: A valid caste certificate in the format provided by DoP&T vide O.M. No. 36036/2/2013-Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and further clarification vide DoP&T OM No. 36011/1/12-Estt.(Res.) dated 14.03.2016 is required. The certificate must mention non-creamy layer status (issued by an authority mentioned in DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36012/22/93-Estt. (SCT) dated 8.9.1993). Only OBC applicants belonging to the Non-Creamy Layer whose caste appears in the Central List of OBCs (notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment on the recommendations of the National Commission for Backward Classes, website http://ncbc.nic.in) are eligible under the OBC category. The non-creamy layer certificate should be for the financial year 2026-2027 (considering income up to the financial year ending 31st March 2026), issued on or after 01st April 2026. If the applicant does not have a certificate valid for 2026-2027 at the time of registration, the previously issued (older) certificate must be submitted with the acknowledgement slip of the renewal application. When asked to submit the valid certificate, the applicant must produce the certificate valid for 2026-2027 within the applicable date along with the old certificate. This additional certificate must refer to the already issued original caste certificate. EWS: Vacancies under EWS are as per DoPT, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pension, Govt. of India, OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. Applications are considered subject to submission of an Income and Assets certificate in the prescribed format issued by the competent authority and verification of its genuineness. An EWS certificate based on the income of financial year 2025-2026, issued on or after 01.04.2026 and valid for the financial year 2026-2027, will be considered valid. PwBD: PwBD candidates may apply against posts identified for PwBD. Applicants with disabilities mentioned in Section 32(1) of the Rights of Persons with Disability Act, 2016, are eligible provided they have benchmark disability (equal to or more than 40%). A Disability Certificate issued by a Competent Authority in the prescribed format is required to avail reservation. | Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi Government/Autonomous bodies must submit a "No Objection Certificate" from their respective employer at the time of interview. Otherwise, the candidate will not be permitted to attend the interview and the candidature will be rejected.

salary_details.details: The emoluments are consolidated in nature, as determined by the Competent Authority. The appointee will not be entitled to benefits such as Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regularly appointed Government servants. The appointee is also not entitled to allowances or facilities extended to regular/permanent faculty members of AIIMS Bhopal; however, hostel facility may be provided as per rules and subject to availability.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Assistant Professor Selection Process
content_sections.text: Application by email: Eligible candidates send the filled application with supporting documents. Screening test (if required): If the number of candidates is more than 1:10 ratio, a screening test may be conducted. Document verification: Conducted one day prior to the interview. After scrutiny of documents against eligibility criteria/conditions/NOC for specified candidates, only eligible candidates are allowed to appear before the Selection Committee. Interview: Before the Selection Committee at Kautilya Bhawan (Administration Building), AIIMS, Saket Nagar, Bhopal-462020. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the document verification or interview. Candidates are advised to make their own stay arrangements, as the interview will be conducted the next day after document verification. The Executive Director, AIIMS Bhopal reserves the right to reschedule the date, time and venue of the interview at any stage. The decision of the Competent Authority regarding selection is final, and no representation will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal) for filling various faculty positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The posts advertised are Assistant Professor across various medical departments and super-specialty disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 45 vacancies available for the Assistant Professor position on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 11-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their filled application forms along with necessary documents through email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 1,42,506/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years, with age relaxations provided as per Government of India rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognized medical qualification (MD/MS/DM/M.Ch) in the respective discipline with relevant teaching or research experience.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: General, OBC, and EWS candidates are required to pay Rs. 2,000/-, while SC, ST, PwBD, and women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection process includes screening of applications, document verification, and a personal interview conducted by the institute.
